all_model_roles: same Gemma 3 4B IT revision; separate contexts and no edited observer
development_futility: Do not skip planned cases based on early results; all 48 x 4 frames per size run.
selection: Largest size passing every development gate; assess selected size once on fresh calibration. No fallback after calibration failure.
gate_definition: Overall and every frame winner accuracy >=.8; joint winner and two numeric influences >=.8 overall; all-four-frames decoded-winner consistency >=.9. Invalid or missing answers are failures, including consistency.
test_baseline_gate: Apply same criteria on unedited test cases before attack claims; failure terminates confirmatory interpretation without retuning.
downstream_implementation: Freeze any later-stage implementation in an append-only manifest before test weights are provided to editor or any test response is generated. It cannot alter this protocol or frozen calibration harness.
